Do we have a high-confidence way to reproduce the issue? Current-main source keeps changed-workspace scanning inside quiescence, and the submitted native parent comparison records the resulting guest pauses; no target code was executed during this review. Is this the best way to solve the issue? The change reuses existing snapshot, lease, staging, and acceptance owners; its fallback and cleanup serve the same invariant without adding another state owner. ([`src/gateway/worker-environments/local-workspace-checkpoint.ts:103`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/d290127ec6750ac3b3504d44ab50b7cee5f92ec7/src/gateway/worker-environments/local-workspace-checkpoint.ts#L103), [d290127ec675](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d290127ec6750ac3b3504d44ab50b7cee5f92ec7)) - **Snapshot lifecycle and complete fallback:** Capture is restricted to btrfs subvolume roots; incomplete snapshots re-pause and use the existing live-tree capture under the same lease. ([`src/gateway/worker-environments/local-workspace-checkpoint.ts:48`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/32b8f86f7fc49989f7ae6ab5c1346831b82b5be6/src/gateway/worker-environments/local-workspace-checkpoint.ts#L48), [32b8f86f7fc4](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/32b8f86f7fc49989f7ae6ab5c1346831b82b5be6)) - **Canonical consistency remains awaited:** The ordinary path resumes after durable Git staging, and finalization still awaits canonical reconciliation and acceptance. ([`src/gateway/worker-environments/local-workspace-state.ts:355`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/32b8f86f7fc49989f7ae6ab5c1346831b82b5be6/src/gateway/worker-environments/local-workspace-state.ts#L355), [32b8f86f7fc4](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/32b8f86f7fc49989f7ae6ab5c1346831b82b5be6)) - **Previous finding resolved:** The final commit moves LocalWorkspaceCapture into the existing leaf types module and updates all five consumers directly, without a checkpoint re-export.
